risk_note: RV2 by path (admin/infra/admin-account-writes, platform/export-store, platform/queue/catalog). Personal information copy generation and delivery (BR-ID-40): a new identity data-copy job and queue (lease 600 s, at-least-once delivery, run token; a separate object key per run, recorded before upload); in_app_sms packs the B1-27f sections into a WinZip AES-256 ZIP (node:crypto / zlib, no new dependency) with a CSPRNG extraction code that is never stored or logged; delivered, audit rows, the expire job and the inbox message commit together, an SMS not accepted rolls it all back to failed and deletes the file; wecom_session seals the copy with the server field key (ready); per-copy expire jobs delete the file and move ready / delivered to expired; disabling the registrant fails their undelivered wecom_session copies in the disable transaction; the deletion cleanup cancels open copies and deletes the user's copy files after commit. No amounts, no ledger, settlement or payout state; no contract or schema change. Rule tests by an independent Claude (approvals #36), three rounds, red before the implementation; implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent.
